how: Opened getemoji.com and selected three emoji sections (People and Fantasy, Clothing and Accessories, Pale Emojis) with a DOM range, then ran document.execCommand("copy").
notes: Selection of three sections of getemoji.com: ~1,100 emoji in 4 KB of plain text including skin-tone modifiers and ZWJ sequences, in 1 MB of HTML (every emoji is its own element with a long computed style). Checks surrogate pairs and joiners survive.
